newsitem.title: MOROCCO: PRESS DIGEST - Morocco economic weeklies - April 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Morocco economic weeklies - April 17.

text.p: These are the leading stories in Morocco's economic press. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- France's Lyonnaise des Eaux takeover of Casablanca's water and electricity distribution will not be easy as the firm is committed to provide better services on strict deadlines.
- State-owned airline Royal Air Maroc discloses a five-year strategy aiming at modernising its fleet, reducing the debt ratio and reaching $600 million turnover.
- Stock Exchange seems to calm down after more than three months of bullish trend.

- Takeover of France's Lyonnaise des Eaux of Casablanca water and electricity distribution is best example of national consensus as it was approved by all members of the city council after amendments on initial deal.
